sections.content: Combine causal, consequential, contrastive and purposive connectors to build a clear argument.

items.spanish: La medida es útil porque reduce los costes; además, protege el medio ambiente.
items.english: The measure is useful because it reduces costs; furthermore, it protects the environment.

items.spanish: Es una solución cara; sin embargo, puede lograr buenos resultados.
items.english: It is an expensive solution; however, it can achieve good results.

items.spanish: El camino estaba dañado; por eso, y para evitar más problemas, propusieron un proyecto más pequeño.
items.english: The road was damaged; therefore, and to avoid further problems, they proposed a smaller project.
